about: Jeremy F. Rosenthal is the founding partner at Rosenthal Kalabus & Therrian, which is located in McKinney, Texas. He is a criminal defense lawyer with two decades of legal experience. Board-certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in criminal law, he provides knowledgeable counsel to his clients.

An empathetic attorney, Mr. Rosenthal understands the fear that accompanies every legal case. Striving to keep his clients at ease, he stands by them, providing them consolation during this difficult time. Mr. Rosenthal is a zealous advocate for those accused of wrongdoing and handles every case by tailoring strategies and solutions to each client’s unique case.

With a bachelor’s degree from the Texas Tech University, Mr. Rosenthal earned his Juris Doctor from the Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law. Actively affiliated with prominent legal organizations, Mr. Rosenthal is two-time president of the McKinney Bar Association, committee chair of Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, super fellow of the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Educational Institute.

Mr. Rosenthal currently serves as the chairman of the Criminal Law section of the Collin County Bar Association. A member of the Plano Bar Association of Texas and the Texas Bar College, he is also an instructor at the Collin County Bar Association Trial Academy. He was past board member of the Collin County Criminal Defense Lawyer’s Association.

An exceptional writer, Mr. Rosenthal blogs regularly on important criminal law matters. He has lectured at prominent seminars related to handling criminal emergencies and trial advocacy. He has been featured multiple times by the State bar of Texas. Mr. Rosenthal has obtained numerous not guilty verdicts in first-degree felonies to serious misdemeanors, and he has a “Superb” rating on Avvo.
